body:
Most branding agencies quote six weeks to six months for a new identity.

But a growing number of studios now deliver a brand identity in one or two weeks, usually as a fixed-price “brand sprint.”

As a branding designer in New York who delivers identities in one week myself, I wanted to see who else does it well.

I searched agency websites, sprint pages and directories, and I also asked AI assistants which studios they recommend for a fast brand.

Below are 12 studios that publish a one-week or two-week timeline, plus my own offer at the end.

For each, I cover the location, price, timeline, past work and how to get in touch.

13 branding agencies that deliver in one week (or two)

  1. A+M Studio
  2. Studio Madz
  3. Lovendear Design
  4. Ellie Brown Branding
  5. Aviso Studios
  6. Brand Purist
  7. Upspire Labs
  8. Foundation
  9. Proof of Work Studio
  10. Digital Surgeons
  11. idgram
  12. Primary
  13. Ebaqdesign

How I chose these agencies

When I asked AI assistants for fast branding agencies, the answers were mixed.

They named a few genuine sprint studios, but also big agencies like Red Antler, Focus Lab and Koto, whose projects usually take six weeks or more.

So I checked every studio’s own website and kept only those that met four criteria.

  • A published timeline of two weeks or less for a brand identity.
  • A clear scope, ideally with a published price.
  • A real portfolio of finished identities, not just templates.
  • A direct way to get in touch, such as an email, form or booking calendar.

I left out logo marketplaces, 48-hour template services and strategy-only workshops that don’t deliver a visual identity.

Prices and timelines come from each studio’s website in October 2026, so check them again before you book.

One-week and two-week branding agencies compared

Here is a quick comparison before the detailed reviews.

The one-week studios mostly serve small businesses and personal brands, while the two-week sprints are aimed at funded startups and include more strategy.

1. A+M Studio

A+M Studio is a two-person brand and design studio for startups, run by Angel and Miles.

A+M Studio portfolio page. Screenshot: A+M Studio. Image source.

Their one-week branding sprint is the clearest offer on this list: one flat price, one focused week.

I like that the portfolio leads with big, confident covers rather than tiny thumbnails.

SoftCare, DadWell and Correm each get one strong photograph or color field with the wordmark set large on top.

That tells me the studio thinks about how an identity reads at a glance, which is exactly what a founder needs before a launch or a raise.

The process starts with two moodboard directions, then a single brand concept refined through daily feedback.

That is a sensible way to make a week work: you choose a direction early, then all the time goes into one idea.

Location: Not listed; prices are quoted in GBP
Timeline: 1 week for branding; 2 weeks for branding and website
Price: £3,500 (about $4,750) for branding; £7,000 with a website; £1,250 for a pitch deck
Past work: RECRD, Correm, SiteLevel, DadWell, Rhede, SoftCare
Contact: Project form or a 15-minute call on Cal.com

Visit A+M Studio.

2. Studio Madz

Studio Madz is a brand and web studio in Venice Beach, California, led by designer Maddie.

Studio Madz work page. Screenshot: Studio Madz. Image source.

The Design Sprint covers a brand identity or a website in five days, aimed at coaches, authors and creators launching something new.

The portfolio is personal and colorful: script wordmarks for Aliza Kelly and Kaelin & Kyrah, a bold illustrated WHATEVER mark, and soft pastel launch graphics.

I think that range makes sense for personal brands, where the founder’s personality is the product.

Maddie is open about the limits, too: the sprint works best when you know what you want or already have a brand to build on.

The week includes a clarity call beforehand, a custom project dashboard, and one week of Slack support after launch.

Location: Venice Beach, California
Timeline: 5 days
Price: $2,950 per Design Sprint
Past work: Logan Ury, Cohort, Amber Rae, Aliza Kelly, Kaelin and Kyrah, Daydreamers
Contact: maddie@studiomadz.com, the project form or an intro call on Cal.com

Visit Studio Madz.

3. Lovendear Design

Lovendear Design is a small branding and web studio run by designer AnneMarie, working with service businesses such as photographers, planners and interior designers.

Lovendear Design portfolio page. Screenshot: Lovendear Design. Image source.

Her Brand Nurture Week builds a complete visual brand in five days, with a different part of the identity covered each day.

The portfolio has a consistent romantic tone: serif typography, warm neutrals, botanical patterns and seal-like monograms.

I like the She Who Magnifies identity in particular, where a repeating leaf pattern carries the brand as much as the wordmark does.

That kind of secondary graphic system is useful for small businesses, because it fills packaging, social posts and web backgrounds without overusing the logo.

The package is generous for the price: a logo suite, monogram and icons, patterns, a business card, a style guide and three extra deliverables you pick.

Location: Not listed; studio hours are 10am–5pm Eastern
Timeline: 5 days (Monday to Friday)
Price: $2,900, with payment plans available
Past work: She Who Magnifies, Ashley Wells Interior Design, Saugatuck Wine & Sports Lab, Cobblestone Weddings, Golden Collective
Contact: hello@lovendear.com or the client application form

Visit Lovendear Design.

4. Ellie Brown Branding

Ellie Brown Branding is a brand and website designer for private practice owners, service providers and entrepreneurs, based in Cañon City, Colorado.

Ellie Brown Branding portfolio page. Screenshot: Ellie Brown Branding. Image source.

Brand in a Week takes you from questionnaire to a finished set of logos, colors and fonts in seven days.

The portfolio shows mostly therapy, wellness and coaching brands, presented as real applications rather than flat logo sheets.

In the Evolve Therapy project, the purple wordmark appears on a candle label, signage and a printed pillow, which helps a client imagine using the brand.

I would describe the style as friendly and polished, a good fit for practices where trust and warmth matter more than edgy design.

You get three custom logos, a tailored color palette, a font selection and a brand style sheet.

Location: Cañon City, Colorado; serves clients worldwide
Timeline: 1 week
Price: $1,950, or three monthly payments of $650
Past work: Evolve Therapy & Consulting, The Kara Report, Manistee Dan, Luxe Aesthetics + Wellness
Contact: hello@elliebrownbranding.com or the contact form

Visit Ellie Brown Branding.

5. Aviso Studios

Aviso Studios is a brand, Squarespace website and marketing studio for small service businesses, run by strategist Liz Kroft in Santa Cruz, California.

Aviso Studios portfolio page. Screenshot: Aviso Studios. Image source.

Brand in a Week is the most affordable one-week package I found from a studio with a real portfolio.

The portfolio is presented as business stories rather than just visuals, with headlines like “The Business Was Growing. Let’s Get Everyone Booked.”

I appreciate that, because it shows the studio connects the identity to a measurable result, such as bookings or website traffic.

The scope is deliberately tight: one logo concept, two variations, a 3–4 color palette, a typography pairing and a one-page style sheet.

That makes it best for a business that needs to look credible quickly, not one that wants to explore several creative routes.

Location: Santa Cruz, California; serves clients nationwide
Timeline: 5 days
Price: $1,700, with monthly payment plans available
Past work: Case studies for wellness practices, service businesses and Squarespace websites
Contact: Booking page with an option to schedule a discovery call

Visit Aviso Studios.

6. Brand Purist

Brand Purist is a branding agency in Shoreditch, London, and one of the early adopters of the brand sprint format.

Brand Purist branding projects page. Screenshot: Brand Purist. Image source.

Their Brand Sprint runs ten days and is built from modules you choose: strategy, naming, verbal identity and visual identity.

I think that modular pricing is smart, because a founder who already has a name should not pay for a naming process.

The work is clean and confident, with bold color blocks and simple geometric marks, like the Key Business Consultants and Playfilled identities.

Playfilled is my favorite here: its stretched, outlined letterforms look playful without losing the professionalism a people consultancy needs.

The workshops are run online, so the format suits decisive solo founders and small teams anywhere.

Location: Shoreditch, London, UK; works online
Timeline: 10 days; a six-week Rebrand Sprint is also offered
Price: Strategy sprint $1,950, naming $1,450, verbal identity $1,650, visual identity $2,950 (£1,450, £1,050, £1,250 and £2,250, before VAT)
Past work: Huddle, Shape Beyond, Reading Mate, ViB Community, Sorel Point, Glamp, Playfilled
Contact: hey@brandpurist.com or a 30-minute call on Calendly

Visit Brand Purist.

7. Upspire Labs

Upspire Labs is a Silicon Valley agency building brands and websites for deep tech startups in AI, cybersecurity and biotech.

Upspire Labs case studies page. Screenshot: Upspire Labs. Image source.

Their Brand Sprint is one of the most transparent offers on this list, with a day-by-day schedule published on the page.

Day one is a workshop, days four and five are design, day six is a review of three or four logo concepts, and day ten is delivery.

The portfolio is dark, cinematic and technical, with black-and-white product imagery for clients like Kascaid, Quokka and Corsair.

That mood is a deliberate choice for deep tech: it makes complex, early companies look established and credible to investors.

They also limit each sprint to three core decision-makers, which I think is one of the most important rules for keeping a fast project on schedule.

Location: 3031 Tisch Way, San Jose, California
Timeline: 10 working days
Price: $10,000 fixed, with a 50% deposit; extra scope billed at $175 an hour
Past work: HyperGo, LGTC Group, Quokka, Corsair, Kascaid
Contact: hello@upspirelabs.com or schedule a call

Visit Upspire Labs.

8. Foundation

Foundation is a London brand strategy and design agency for technology, science and innovation companies.

Foundation homepage with selected work. Screenshot: Foundation. Image source.

Their Brand Sprint is summed up in four words on the page: “10 days. £10k.”

What I like is how much the package covers: a strategy workshop, messaging, two creative concepts, guidelines, plus presentation and social templates.

The portfolio mixes calm editorial typography with striking, high-contrast imagery, such as the pixel-grid mark for Envisics and the neon-green identity for Neuroptics.

That balance suits technical businesses, which need to look innovative but not gimmicky.

A Squarespace one-page website is included, although you pay for your own Squarespace, Canva Pro and domain subscriptions.

Location: 77 East Road, London N1 6AH, UK
Timeline: 10 days
Price: £10,000 fixed, before VAT; 50% deposit before the workshop
Past work: DOYOU, Supervene, OBOT, Envisics, Trustonic
Contact: info@studiofoundation.com, +44 20 7993 6799, or book a call on Calendly

Visit Foundation.

9. Proof of Work Studio

Proof of Work Studio is a London studio for funded startups, led by co-founders and creative directors Charlie Simpson and David Henshaw.

Proof of Work Studio work page. Screenshot: Proof of Work Studio. Image source.

Their two-week Brand Sprint puts strategy in week one and identity in week two, with files handed over on day fourteen.

The portfolio leans into tech and crypto infrastructure, with glossy 3D renders, deep blues and product screens for Datagram, Hemi and Vetro.

I like that the work is shown in real use, like the Datagram mark on a device, rather than as isolated logos.

The discovery stage is asynchronous: a questionnaire and a competitive teardown instead of day-long workshops.

That is a good fit for busy founding teams who can’t give up a full day in the middle of a fundraise.

Location: London, UK
Timeline: 2 weeks
Price: $15,000 fixed; the Web Sprint is $10,000–$20,000
Past work: OSMI AI, Datagram, Hemi, Vetro, Gala
Contact: workwithus@proofofwork.studio or the contact form

Visit Proof of Work Studio.

10. Digital Surgeons

Digital Surgeons is a full-service brand, marketing and technology agency headquartered in New Haven, Connecticut, with offices in Miami, New York and San Francisco.

Digital Surgeons work page. Screenshot: Digital Surgeons. Image source.

It is the largest agency on this list, and its Brand Sprint promises a launch-ready brand system in about two weeks.

The portfolio is bold and varied, from the GPC identity for an AI consultancy to the neon LIFTD cans and the Four Roses bourbon campaign.

I like the LIFTD work for its loud, stacked type and fluorescent colors, which make the product impossible to miss on a shelf.

The sprint covers strategy, a full identity, guidelines, source files and an asset library.

Pricing is not published, so expect to discuss budget on an intro call.

Location: 470 James Street, New Haven, Connecticut; also Miami, New York and San Francisco
Timeline: About 2 weeks
Price: Not published; quoted after an intro call
Past work: GPC, Token, LIFTD, Four Roses, Endless Commerce, Rapsodo
Contact: info@digitalsurgeons.com or the contact form

Visit Digital Surgeons.

11. idgram

idgram is an identity-focused studio that builds logo and brand systems for growing companies, rather than general design production.

idgram selected work section. Screenshot: idgram. Image source.

Its Brand Sprint delivers a complete identity system in two to three weeks, with a cheaper Brand Foundation option over four to six weeks.

The selected work is strictly monochrome, with geometric symbols, repeating patterns on stationery and detailed guideline pages for Event Horizon.

I like this restraint, because it puts the focus on structure: how the mark, grid and typography work together across many touchpoints.

The studio takes on only two active projects at a time and promises direct access to the specialist doing the work.

Deliverables include a logo and refined wordmark, color and type systems, a brand book, a social starter kit and Figma source files.

Location: Not listed; prices are quoted in euros
Timeline: 2–3 weeks (Brand Sprint) or 4–6 weeks (Brand Foundation)
Price: €24,500 for the Brand Sprint; €8,500 for the Brand Foundation
Past work: Vateris, Event Horizon, Downlink
Contact: hello@idgram.com

Visit idgram.

12. Primary

Primary is a brand sprint studio for startups whose team says it draws on two decades at Pentagram and Milton Glaser.

Primary work page. Screenshot: Primary. Image source.

It is the premium option here: a full brand in two weeks for a flat $50,000.

The portfolio is the strongest on this list, led by the glowing pink heart for Lovable and playful 3D lettering for Craft.

I like how each identity has one ownable idea that works instantly at small sizes, from an app icon to a billboard.

Primary takes one project at a time, and the booking form asks up front whether you are ready to invest $50,000.

That honesty saves everyone time, and it tells you this is for funded startups that need to look category-leading on launch day.

Location: Not listed on the website
Timeline: 2 weeks; bookings currently 4–6 weeks out
Price: $50,000 flat fee
Past work: Lovable, Craft, Paper, Owner, Solidroad, Heron
Contact: Intro call form, leading to a Calendly booking

Visit Primary.

13. Ebaqdesign

Ebaqdesign is my independent branding practice in New York, and a one-week brand identity is my core offer.

Ebaqdesign selected work page. Image source.

I’m Arek Dvornechuck, a Branding Expert with over 20 years of experience.

Before starting my own practice, I worked with leading design firms, including Chermayeff & Geismar & Haviv.

Unlike most studios on this list, there is no account manager or junior team: you work directly with me from the first call to the final files.

A scoped brand identity or rebrand is delivered in one week for $3,000 total, covering the logo system, colors, typography and practical guidelines.

Website design, development and motion can follow in extra weeks at the same weekly rate, with the total agreed before work begins.

For recent examples, see Savory’s real-estate identity, the Periti Digital brand and the Airport Executive rebrand and website, or browse the full portfolio.

Location: New York City; working with clients worldwide
Timeline: 1 week for a brand identity or rebrand
Price: $3,000 total; additional weeks at $3,000
Past work: Savory, Periti Digital, Airport Executive, Orbio, NextDim AI, Fox Berman
Contact: Book a call

What makes a one-week brand sprint work?

Speed is not the hard part; decisions are.

Every studio here limits something: the number of decision-makers, the number of concepts, or the number of revision rounds.

Before you book, I would prepare three things: a short description of your business and audience, a few brands you admire, and one person with final say.

Also check exactly what the price includes, because “brand identity” can mean a single logo or a full system with guidelines and templates.

If you need naming, deep research or a large website, plan for two weeks or more.
